title: Ning Li's spinning superconductors; NASA fails to reproduce

plain: The physicist Ning Li claimed that spinning superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance, produced an unusual effect, but when NASA, the US space agency, tried to reproduce it, they did not see the effect. Charles Buhler, presented on the show as a NASA figure working on new propulsion, tells this from memory and hedges ("someone, I think NASA"). He brings it up as an example of a claimed gravity-related breakthrough that did not hold up when others tested it.
